Q: This is the adjuster speaking. The call is being recorded with your permission. Please state your full name for the
record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision at the
intersection in Pasadena, Texas?
A: Yes, I was drviing my sedan. I had a green light going through the intersection.
Q: Can you describe what happened?
A: I was about halfway across when a pickup coming from my right ran the red light and hit the driver's side of my car.
The impact spun me partway around. I didn't see him until the last second, so I couldn't brake in time.
Q: Did you notice any traffic signal changes before the impact?
A: My light was green the whole time I was approaching. I'm pretty sure of that.
Q: Were there any other vehicles or witnesses nearby?
A: A car was stopped at the far corner, but I don't know if they saw anything. I didn't get any names.
Q: Did you seek medical treatment after the collision?
A: Yes. Paramedics checked me at the scene, and then I went to the emergency room. They told me I fractured my
left wrist. I'm wearing a splint now and I'm waiting to see a specialist.
Q: Are you able to work or perform normal daily activities at the moment?
A: Not really. I'm right-handed and I can't grip or lift much with the left, so it's slowed down everything at home.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. Thanks.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
